report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 9 mm tümü ile mediale ekstrüdedir. Ekstrüde menisküste belirgin volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtıklar izlenmiştir.Lateral menisküs anterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmektedir.Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlenmiştir. Posterior çapraz bağ proksimal kesimde incelme ve sinyal artışı izlenmiştir.Medial kollateral ligamanda periligamantöz ödem izlenmiştir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patella medial fasette kartilajda destrüksiyon, subkondral alanda kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde yaygın sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral-marginal osteofitik formasyonu izlenmiştir.Tibiofemoral eklem  medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral skleroz, ödem ve dejeneratif kistler izlenmiştir. Bu düzeylerde kartilajlarda desktrüksiyon izlenmiştir. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlanmıştır.Tibia interkondiler eminensia anterior ve posteriorunda çapraz bağlar insersiyo düzeyinde subkortikal alanda büyüğü 1 cm çaplı kistler izlenmiştir.Popliteal fossada 7x4 cm boyutlu baker kisti izlenmiştir.Sonuç: Gonatroz, medial menisküste medial ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtıklar, lateral menisküste grade III meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptür, posterior çapraz bağ proksimalinde diffüz incelme, tibia interkondiler eminensiada dejeneratif kistler, suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit, patella medial fasette grade 4 kondromalazi, popliteal fossada baker kisti .

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    5 weeks ago patient felt popping sensation in the right knee during rotation motion. Able to weight-bear at the time of injury and presently tenderness at fibular head. Difficulty flexing the past 90 degrees. Ultrasound revealed effusion with synovial thickening and positive McMurray's test for medial aspect in clinic.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

There are no normal intact fibers of the anterior cruciate ligament in keeping with a complete mid fiber tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The finding is associated with an anterior tibial drawer measured in the lateral joint compartment of about 8 mm. There is evidence of resolving bone contusions in the anterior lateral femoral condyle with slightly depressed anterior sulcus and resolving bone contusions in the posterior lateral tibial plateau. Findings are consistent with resolving kissing contusions related to a pivot shift mechanism of injury. There is also edema in the posterior aspect of the medial tibial plateau.

Buckling of the posterior cruciate ligament is noted in association with the anterior tibial drawer. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

The medial collateral ligament is intact. There is some mild intrinsic signal around the deep fibers of the medial collateral ligament in keeping with a low-grade medial collateral ligament sprain.

The lateral collateral ligament complex is intact including the fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon, the popliteus tendon and the IT band.

There is an undisplaced vertical tear of the peripheral one third of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending into the posterior aspect of the posterior body. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment are well-maintained.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable. The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and unremarkable. Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained. The TT-TG distance is within normal limits.

There is no significant Baker's cyst or significant knee effusion. There is mild reactive synovitis within the joint.

INTERPRETATION: 

Complete anterior cruciate ligament tear of mid fibers associated with a significant anterior tibial drawer.

Resolving kissing bone contusions in association with pivot shift mechanism of injury.

Low-grade sprain of the medial fibers of medial collateral ligament.

Undisplaced radial tear of peripheral one third of posterior horn of medial meniscus extending into posterior body.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemorales sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Tendón
cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales.
Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica

Fokale vollschichtige T2-Signalanhebung bei Läsion 
des Gelenkknorpels am dorsolateralen Tibiaplateau mit fokalem i.e.L. degenerativ bedingtem subchondralem Knochenmarksödem der Tibia (4/24). Desweiteren kein Knochenmarksödem, keine Stufenbildung oder Impression der Kortikalis. Gering lateralisierte Patella ohne umgebendes Ödemsignal sowie bei unauffälligen Bandstrukturen. Keine Trochleadysplasie. 
Unauffällige Signalgebung und Konfiguration der Menisci, kein Nachweis einer Rissbildung oder degenerativer Signalveränderungen. 
Intakte Darstellung der Kreuzbänder, kein Shift der Tibia. Intakte Darstellung der Kollateralbänder. Kein wesentlicher Gelenkserguss. 
Gering s.c. Ödem am Unterschenkel miterfasst. Unauffällige Signalgebung der miterfassten Muskulatur.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Disfunción patelofemoral izquierda.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura. Aumento de señal
del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar con la superficie
articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
No se observan lesiones condrales categóricas de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la
tróclea femoral. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la faceta medial de la rótula, sin cambios
óseos secundarios.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales. El
discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial, correlacionar con clínica
